To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a robust method to measure low frequency noise of AlGaN/Gan Heterostructures using Hall crosses.

1) the cross shaped 4-terminal device allows to perform LF noise measurement on-wafer with a high throughput and with no additional fabrication step; 2) the noise measurement is not affected by any bias current; 3) the noise is not affected by the presence of a magnetic field, which is a major advantage for Hall effect measurement.
the proposed method is a robust, versatile, and direct low-frequency noise method for material/processes and quality control.
